(2) A man appears in the frame, wearing a black cap and a blue denim jacket. He is standing in front of a digital background depicting military tanks and missile launchers in an open field under a cloudy sky. He gestures with his hands as he speaks. (3) A 3D animated map of East Asia is shown, highlighting Taiwan and the coastal region of China. The colors are muted green and blue. (4) A person with dark hair tied in a ponytail is shown from behind, looking at a large vertical screen filled with lines of computer code and data interfaces. The environment is a dimly lit workspace. (5) A close-up shot focuses on a white toilet paper roll inside a holder being pulled. The background is a clean, tiled bathroom wall with soft lighting. (6) The man in the denim jacket returns, speaking with high energy and using exaggerated hand movements. (7) A low-angle shot shows a person's legs with blue trousers pulled down to the ankles, sitting on a toilet in a brightly lit bathroom. (8) A close-up displays white paper napkins stacked in a clear glass container on a wooden surface. (9) The final scene is a graphic overlay featuring the man on the right and large text boxes on the left against a background of the logistics warehouse.
